title: Thai-Style Delightful Steamed Dumplings
description: A twist on traditional Thai street food, these dumplings are served with a vibrant dipping sauce.
instructions: 1. In a large pot, bring water to a boil.
2. Place the dumpling wrappers in the boiling water for 2-3 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
3. Remove the dumplings from the water and place them on a steamer basket.
4. Steam the dumplings for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until they are cooked through.
5. While the dumplings are steaming, prepare the vibrant dipping sauce by mixing together equal parts of soy sauce and rice vinegar in a small bowl.
6. Serve the steamed dumplings with the vibrant dipping sauce and pretzel buns on the side.
7. Enjoy your delicious Thai-style steamed dumplings!
